table_cells: Direct raw-controller integration cannot preserve controller administration
Direct addition and continued administration cannot coexist under the named raw controller's single-admin semantics.
Shared FeeDistributor eligibility leaves confiscation without a completion bound
Every confiscation requires the same cooldown-gated checkpoint; ordinary distributor activity and other confiscations share its cursor.
Immutable settlement dependencies have no terminal resolution path
deepseek-v4.1-flash, glm-5.3, glm-5.3-flash, gpt-6-astra, gpt-6.1-sol, kimi-k3.1, qwen3.8-flash-next
A permanently unusable frozen ingress or FeeDistributor can leave the entire outstanding balance reserved indefinitely.
Paid admission does not bind the payer's expected venue configuration
Admission binds the owner-selected defaults at execution, without a payer commitment or independent adapter-identity check.
Funded VoteMarket ingress has no destination reconciliation
deepseek-v4.1-flash, glm-5.3, glm-5.3-flash, gpt-6-astra, kimi-k3.1, qwen3.8-flash-next, qwen4-max
The local liability is retired on funded L1 submission even though destination creation and delivery are separate events.
VoteMarket campaign residuals lack a project-controlled recovery path
glm-5.3, glm-5.3-flash, gpt-6-astra, gpt-6.1-sol, qwen3.8-flash-next, qwen4-max
The adapter names itself as manager but provides no campaign lifecycle or residual recovery operation.
VoteMarket gas settings can leave existing routes unfundable
The adapter manager's settings are bounded for arithmetic, not affordability, and apply to pending listings.
Stale distributor cursor is a separate confiscation availability gate
The coverage guard correctly retains escrow until safe checkpoint accounting is available after a stale cursor.
Maintenance and confiscation share checkpoint telemetry
Standalone `FeeCheckpointResult(true)` certifies a call return only. Indexers should use `EscrowConfiscated` for settlement completion.
Exact approvals use an unconditional pre-zero call
The normal allowance-cleared path still issues pre-zero. Keep the compatibility behavior unless a verified token-specific change is justified.
VoteMarket receipt is derived, not stored in its compatibility field
The retained field is written as zero; use the getters and event for the receipt and preserve layout compatibility.
Zero-share addresses are not validated as funding targets
A snapshot address on a zero-share leg need not identify a venue. Consumers should interpret the split before using either address.
Maturity projection differentiates a killed gauge from an unreadable flag
releasable` returns zero for a killed Active gauge and propagates a flag-read failure. Schedulers should retain that distinction.
Test fixtures are inside the configured contract source root
Fixtures have test-only unrestricted controls. Keep them out of the production candidate allowlist and verify pins independently of code presence.
Token decimals rejection uses the admission-configuration diagnostic
Constructor diagnostics reuse `BadAdmissionConfig` for a different dependency check. Document the distinction for operator tooling.

Funded L1 ingress retires escrow without establishing destination funding or retaining an ordinary project recovery route.
Paid admission does not bind the payer to reviewed routing terms
gpt-6.1-sol, qwen4-max, qwen3.8-flash-next, deepseek-v4.1-flash, glm-5.3-flash, glm-5.3
The payer cannot condition admission on the approved venue configuration in effect at execution.
Unprocessed Votium incentives have no project-controlled recovery
The venue records the adapter as depositor, but the shipped adapter cannot exercise its unprocessed-incentive rights.
gpt-6-astra, gpt-6.1-sol, kimi-k3.1, qwen4-max, deepseek-v4.1-flash, glm-5.3-flash
Direct use of the raw controller does not preserve both listing authorization and controller governance.
Gauge kill authority is external to paid admission

A canonical validator verdict authenticates the configured gauge proof, not the implementation's kill-role policy. Treat the intended gauge implementations and actual kill authority as explicit release checks (`docs/CURVE-PROPOSAL.md:35–36`; `docs/DEPLOYMENT-PINS.md:149–153,173`).
Direct transfers do not create recovery rights
qwen4-max QW-02; deepseek-v4.1-flash I-04; glm-5.3-flash F-02

Direct crvUSD surpluses do not credit a listing or offset later pulls. VoteMarket ETH remains available for future messages but cannot be withdrawn. Size transfers to liabilities and funding needs; retain the no-sweep boundary unless separately reviewed.
Fee checkpoint event has two evidentiary meanings
Standalone `FeeCheckpointResult(true)` means the upstream call returned. Use `EscrowConfiscated` as the escrow completion signal; distinct maintenance telemetry could make this easier to enforce.
Deposit record retains a receipt placeholder
The record retains a zero placeholder for layout stability; the public receipt is derived. Remove it only under a separately reviewed layout and ABI change.
Approval reset adds an intentional token call
A nonzero approval uses a checked zero reset before the exact amount. Account for that call in gas budgets; do not remove the safety step on the strength of this observation.
Fixture ERC20 interface shares a production source file
Fixture methods are used by mocks, not the production core or adapters. A fixture-only module would make that boundary clearer if packaging is reorganized.
Noncanonical Boolean can bypass the named diagnostic
The ABI decoder can revert before `SafeTokenBadReturn`; the token interaction still fails closed. Normalize the diagnostic only if callers require a stable error taxonomy.
The Active branch derives funded amount directly and again inside `_remaining` at source level. Reuse the derived value only if worth a view-path simplification.
Later maturities make deliberate additional flag reads
Budget a flag read for each later due quarter. Retain it: the preceding quarter may have made externally observable calls.
VoteMarket exclusion validation is bounded and quadratic
The pairwise scan preserves caller order with a bounded list. Keep the bound and order semantics if revisiting the validation cost.

table_cells: Shared FeeDistributor eligibility leaves confiscation without a completion bound
gpt-6-astra, gpt-6.1-sol, glm-5.3-flash, glm-5.3, qwen3.8-flash-next, qwen4-max, deepseek-v4.1-flash, kimi-k3.1
The pinned distributor's shared eligibility rule can repeatedly defer terminalization while the remainder stays reserved.
Paid admission does not bind the payer's reviewed venue terms
Admission applies the owner's execution-time defaults without checking the payer's expected endpoints or split.
Failed frozen ingress can keep the whole remainder reserved
A persistent failure in one required venue prevents settlement of the healthy share as well.
Funded ingress is final before downstream fulfillment
gpt-6-astra, gpt-6.1-sol, qwen3.8-flash-next, qwen4-max, deepseek-v4.1-flash, kimi-k3.1
Local escrow expenditure is final without proof of venue processing or destination delivery, and there is no local recredit.
VoteMarket ETH affordability can stop pending settlement
The live per-message budget and available float can block a VoteMarket-bearing checkpoint; the quote covers one message.
Constructors accept the new contract itself as owner
A self-owned core cannot open paid admission, and a self-owned adapter cannot complete binding.
Votium's cap and exclusion terms are live for future deposits even on an older listing. They affect venue allocation inputs, not the custody recipient; monitor authorized updates.
Confiscation is based on the current authoritative kill flag, not a minimum kill duration. A committed confiscation is terminal if the flag later clears. Keep this policy explicit.
The first maturity is the next aligned week boundary, not a full week after payment. Display the scheduled boundary rather than a minimum one-week lock.
handlerId` selects a pool-local slot among matching MetaRegistry handlers, not a global handler identifier. Clarify this in the interface documentation.
The default build source set includes test mocks and the fixture-only ERC-20 interface. Select the production artifact identities explicitly.

Standalone FeeDistributor maintenance success does not attest full allocation coverage. A positive pre-existing delta outside the distributor's bounded coverage can be incompletely allocated; the guarded confiscation path is separate.
VoteMarket's private receipt field stays zero for layout stability; the public getters derive the receipt. Use the getters and events rather than raw storage for evidence.
SafeToken` masks dependency revert bytes, and a malformed Boolean can fail at the decoder rather than the named error. Keep monitoring compatible with both failure forms.
Unsolicited crvUSD does not create listing credit or a sweep right. Adapters preserve their pre-deposit balances.
The mock remote manager checks exact configured ETH value; the production manager forwards supplied value to the messenger. Fixture success is not bridge pricing or refund evidence.
The mock controller grants a designated lister its own addition route; the raw reference controller has an incumbent-admin gate. Do not infer production authority from the mock.
The adapters retain string reverts for ownership proposal and acceptance while the core uses custom errors. Preserve that distinction in diagnostic decoders.
Zero-first approval and final allowance clearing add explicit token calls. Retain those checks unless a replacement is shown to preserve custody and failure behavior.
A zero `confiscate` return can mean an Active, un-killed listing or a terminal record. Use record status and the completion event to distinguish outcomes.

table_cells: gpt-6-astra, glm-5.3-flash, qwen3.8-flash-next, gpt-6.1-sol, deepseek-v4.1-flash, qwen4-max, glm-5.3, kimi-k3.1
A shared checkpoint cursor serializes killed-listing settlements and imposes no completion bound.
Required frozen dependencies can leave the whole remainder reserved
gpt-6-astra, glm-5.3-flash, qwen3.8-flash-next, gpt-6.1-sol, deepseek-v4.1-flash, qwen4-max, glm-5.3
Persistent failure of a required venue or the fixed confiscation destination leaves affected balances backed but unavailable.
VoteMarket source ingress is final without destination confirmation
Successful funded L1 submission retires local liability without requiring a funded L2 campaign.
Venue lifecycle rights have no project-controlled call path
The adapters acquire venue-side identities but expose no callable disposition of eligible unprocessed incentives or campaign residuals.
Lister ownership rotation carries the privileged registration lane
Transferring lister ownership does not change the address-keyed router grant or require a separate authorization for the new owner.
Successor operability is not enforced at controller handback or reseating
An authorized change to an unusable administrator, including a retired router, can permanently disable controller administration.
Constructor does not validate public FeeDistributor checkpoint eligibility
The token and status checks can accept an otherwise valid distributor whose public checkpoint permission is disabled.
Paid admission does not bind the payer's expected terms
A paid listing commits execution-time defaults, not the registry, venues or split the payer previously reviewed.
Frozen routes inherit live adapter-manager terms
Changes to live venue terms or bridge affordability can alter or defer already-admitted settlements.
DAO pin identity must be bound outside the reusable constructor

dao_` is immutable and deliberately need not have code. A different address from the intended executor would not give that executor the router's DAO authority. Independently bind the exact approved executor and callable route before seating; a code check alone is not identity verification.
An incorrect adapter binding requires replacement

A successfully bound adapter cannot be rebound even by a subsequent owner. With an incorrect binding the intended lister rejects paid admission before fee or liability effects. Verify bindings before enablement and replace a misbound adapter.
The immutable validator pin does not freeze verdict availability or policy
A disallowing or unavailable verdict rejects new paid admission, not existing settlement. Monitor the selected predicate and upstream role binding.
Unsolicited balances and unspent VoteMarket float are not locally reclaimable

The router has no rescue surface, unsolicited token balances do not constitute new listing credit, and the VoteMarket float is committed to ingress use with no operator withdrawal. Distinguish excess balance from liability and fund only approved float.
Router layout check requires the documented artifact input

A missing or empty layout cannot satisfy the manifest comparison. Preserve the documented build option that emits `storageLayout` when generating evidence. This is a verification prerequisite, not a contract or canonical-build defect.
Noncanonical Boolean token results have a different failure diagnostic
A 32-byte noncanonical Boolean can fail at `abi.decode` before `SafeTokenBadReturn`; the call still fails closed. Keep the documented distinction unless an error-surface change is approved.
Invalid token decimals share the admission-config diagnostic
A successfully decoded non-18 result reverts construction with `BadAdmissionConfig`, also used for registry/config problems. Diagnose by call context; no admission or custody bypass results.
The maturity label does not bind venue execution timing

Votium uses the execution-time round; the VoteMarket maturity label is a local key and is not a requested destination start time in the payload. Do not infer historical execution or destination scheduling from the maturity label.
